description: A schema for a Total CMS Blog object
formgrid:
id id
title title
draft featured
date author
image image
categories categories
tags tags
summary summary
content content
media media
gallery gallery
extra extra
updated created

draft.label: Draft
draft.help: Mark this post as a draft

mcp.description: Whether the post is a draft. Drafts are auto-hidden from anonymous MCP callers; admin callers see them by default.
Whether the post is featured (typically promoted on the homepage or in highlighted listings).

id.label: Blog Post ID
id.help: A unique ID for this post. No spaces or special characters.

mcp.description: Unique URL-safe slug identifying the post. Appears in the post's public URL (e.g. /blog/{id}).
Display title of the post, shown in listings and as the page H1.
Publication date of the post (ISO 8601). Use for chronological filtering and sorting.
Display name of the post's author.
Short summary or excerpt of the post, shown in listings and meta descriptions. Rich text — request format=markdown for token-efficient output.
Optional URL to associated media (video embed, podcast episode, etc.). Empty when the post has no media.
Main body content of the post. Rich text — request format=markdown for token-efficient output or format=text for plain text.

extra.label: Extra Content
extra.help: Extra content area for this post

mcp.description: Secondary content area for sidebars, footnotes, or supplementary material. Often empty.

categories.label: Categories
categories.help: A list of categories for this post

mcp.description: Categories the post belongs to (array of strings). Filterable with include='categories:tech' to find posts in a category.

tags.label: Tags
tags.help: A list of tags for this post

mcp.description: Tags applied to the post (array of strings). Filterable with include='tags:php'.
Hero/cover image for the post. Object includes name, alt text, width, height. Use the URL builder helpers to construct a fetchable URL.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.help: Gallery of images for this post

mcp.description: Image gallery for the post (array of image objects). Empty when the post has no gallery.
Auto-set timestamp of the last save (ISO 8601). System-managed; not editable by users.
Auto-set timestamp when the post was first created (ISO 8601). System-managed; immutable.
